    14	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` along an arbitrary test change `R → R'`, with the functor laws, the Abel
    15	hook, and the Zariski separation keystone.  This is what makes the widened value a functor
    16	VALUE rather than a bare type: before this file nothing could base-change a widened class.
    17	
    18	## Where the widening does and does not show
    19	
    20	Almost nowhere.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` widens where the pieces live on the CURVE and changes
    21	nothing about the Zariski cover of the BASE, so the base-side machinery of
    22	`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean` — the `Localization.Away` towers, `IsLocalization.map`,
    23	`span_range_algebraMap_eq_top` — applies verbatim; the cover datum only appears inside the

    26	stated for ARBITRARY scheme morphisms and know nothing about covers, so the functor laws are
    27	the same three lines as in the chart-typed case.

    30	
    31	`AffCoverData` demands affineness of the pieces only (that is the R2 shape), so the certificate
    32	transport takes an explicit `hinf` — the overlaps are affine.  A `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`

   230	/-- **Certificate transport, widened** (the S5b keystone at `DivFamZarAff`): the widened
   231	locally-certified predicate is stable under an ARBITRARY test change `R → R'`.
   232	
   233	The base-side argument is untouched by the widening — the pushed cover `algebraMap R R' ∘ g`
   234	spans `⊤` and the certified part over each `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` is
   235	`mapAlg` of the local family — because R2 widens where the pieces live on the CURVE and changes
   236	nothing about the Zariski cover of the BASE.  Compare
   237	`IsLocallyCertified.pullback` (`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean`): the proof is the same, with the
   238	cover datum appearing only inside the opaque `mapAlg`. -/
   239	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.pullback {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   240	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (hreg) :
   241	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R') n
   242	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg) := by
   243	  classical
   244	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
   245	  have hloc' : IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R) n d := ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩
   246	  refine ⟨m, fun i => algebraMap R R' (g i), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
   247	  · have hrange : (Set.range fun i : Fin m => algebraMap R R' (g i))
   248	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
   249	      ext x
   250	      exact ⟨by rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
   251	        by rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
   252	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
   253	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
   254	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
   255	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
   256	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
   257	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) :=
   258	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
   259	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) (algebraMap R R' (g i))
   260	  -- the induced away map as a local algebra tower
   261	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i))
   262	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
   263	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i))
   264	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
   265	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) (algebraMap R R')
   266	      (by
   267	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
   268	        use e
   269	        simp)).toAlgebra
   270	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i))
   271	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
   272	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   273	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
   274	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
   275	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i))
   276	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
   277	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   278	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i)),
   279	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
   280	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i))
   281	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))),
   282	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
   283	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))])
   284	  -- witness transport along `R → Localization.Away (g i) → the pushed chart`
   285	  have hW := G.divEq_mapAlg_pullback n (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
   286	    (G.cover.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper)
   287	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   288	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) hGdiv
   289	  -- the composite collapse through the `R'`-side factorization
   290	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
   291	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
   292	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
   293	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R') (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
   294	  have hstep := Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_pullback hcomp₂ d hreg
   295	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   296	      (relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))
   297	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg))
   298	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   299	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))
   300	  exact ⟨G.mapAlg (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) n
   301	    (G.cover.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper), hW.trans hstep.symm⟩

   303	/-! ## The widened divisor-functor map -/
   304	
   305	/-- **The widened divisor-functor map on locally certified classes** along an ARBITRARY test
   306	change: pull back the representative (the widened mapAlg-hreg engine discharges regularity) and
   307	transport the certificates.  Well defined by `divEq_pullback`.
   308	
   309	With this, `DivFamZarAff` is a functor value: the field-uniform carrier of R2 base-changes
   310	exactly as the chart-typed one did. -/
   311	noncomputable def DivFamZarAff.mapAlg :
   312	    DivFamZarAff C R n → DivFamZarAff C R' n :=
   313	  Quotient.lift
   314	    (fun dp : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} =>
   315	      DivFamZarAff.mk (dp.1.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')
   316	          (dp.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' n))
   317	        (dp.2.pullback R' n _))
   318	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
   319	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') h _ _))
   320	
   321	@[simp]
   322	lemma DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
   323	    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) :
   324	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlg R' n (DivFamZarAff.mk d hd)
   325	      = DivFamZarAff.mk (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')
   326	          (hd.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' n))
   327	        (hd.pullback R' n _) :=
   328	  rfl

   330	/-- **The Abel-hook class law at the widened Zar level**: the divisor-functor map intertwines
   331	the Picard classes with the Čech-Picard pullback, `𝒪(f*D) = f*𝒪(D)`.  Identical to the
   332	chart-typed `DivFamZar.picClass_mapAlg` — the class never saw the cover. -/
   333	lemma DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) :
   334	    (DivFamZarAff.mapAlg R' n F).picClass =
   335	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R R') F.picClass := by
   336	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
   337	  | h d => exact Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') d.1 _
   338	
   339	/-- **The identity functor law** at the widened Zar level. -/
   340	lemma DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_id (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) :
   341	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlg R n F = F := by
   342	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
   343	  | h d =>
   344	      exact DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
   345	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_id relCurveMap_id d.1 _)
   346	
   347	end Transport

   355	/-- **The composition functor law** at the widened Zar level, over a tower `R → R' → R''`. -/
   356	lemma DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_comp (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) :
   357	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlg R'' n (DivFamZarAff.mapAlg R' n F)
   358	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlg R'' n F := by
   359	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
   360	  | h d =>
   361	      exact DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
   362	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_pullback
   363	          (relCurveMap_comp (R' := R') (R'' := R'')) d.1 _ _ _)

   367	/-! ## Zariski separation at the widened Zar level -/
   368	
   369	/-- **Zariski separation of the widened divisor functor**: two widened classes agreeing under
   370	`mapAlg` on every member of a finite covering family of localizations agree.
   371	
   372	Certificates play no role in equality, so — exactly as for `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq` — this
   373	reduces verbatim to the `DivEq`-level engine `divEq_of_divEq_pullback`, and the widening is
   374	invisible.  Note this needs `[IsProper C.hom]` only because `mapAlg` does. -/
   375	theorem DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq [IsProper C.hom] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R)
   376	    (S : ι → Type u)
   377	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
   378	    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
   379	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) {F G : DivFamZarAff C R n}
   380	    (h : ∀ i, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F = DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n G) :
   381	    F = G := by
   382	  haveI : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S i)) := fun i =>
   383	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (S i) (g i)
   384	  revert h
   385	  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ F G fun d₁ d₂ h => ?_
   386	  refine DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ?_
   387	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback
   388	    (fun i => relCurveMap C R (S i))
   389	    (fun y => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R g S hg y)
   390	    (fun i => d₁.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i) n)

     8	/-!
     9	# Zariski gluing of WIDENED locally certified divisor classes (R2 keystone, I-0492)
    10	
    11	**The pinned keystone, ported to the widened carrier** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2 at
    12	`DivFamZarAff`): compatible widened locally certified divisor classes over a finite away cover of
    13	`R` glue to a widened class over `R` restricting to them.
    14	
    15	## Why this ports, and where the only real work was
    16	
    17	R2 (human decision I-0492) widened where the certificate's pieces live ON THE CURVE — arbitrary
    18	affine opens instead of basic opens of two pinned `P¹` charts.  It changed NOTHING about the
    19	Zariski cover of the BASE, and the gluing argument is entirely about the base: it assembles a
    20	divisor with `awayGluedEquationsLoc` and witnesses local certifiability by `mapAlg` of the input
    21	families.  So the route below is the chart-typed `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` with three
    22	mechanical substitutions — `DivFamZar → DivFamZarAff`, `CertifiedDivisorFamily →
    23	CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`, and no `π` anywhere — plus two real costs:
    24	
    25	* the assembly had to be **restated at bare local-equation systems** first, because its
    26	  chart-typed statement demands `CertifiedDivisorFamily` input that a widened class provably
    27	  cannot supply.  That is `DivisorFamilyAffGlueZarKit.lean`; the proof there is verbatim.
    28	* every `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg` carries the overlap-affineness argument `hinf`, free
    29	  here from `[IsProper C.hom]` via `AffCoverData.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper`, which is also
    30	  what `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` itself needs.  Hence `[IsProper C.hom]` in the statement — the DD-R
    31	  lane has it everywhere, the challenge curve being proper over `k`.
    32	
    33	## The route, unchanged from the chart-typed keystone
    34	
    35	Representatives `d i` carry widened local certificate covers `h i : Fin (m i) → S i` with
    36	certified families `G i l` over `Localization.Away (h i l)`.  The composite cover
    37	`r ⟨i, l⟩ := a i l * g i` (numerators `a i l` of the `h i l`, `IsLocalization.Away.sec`) spans `⊤`
    38	(`span_range_num_mul_eq_top`), and the fine carriers `Localization.Away (h i l)` are
    39	`r ⟨i, l⟩`-away localizations of `R`.  The fine overlap carriers receive the coarse overlap
    40	carriers `T i j` by `IsLocalization.Away.lift`; the fine compatibility follows from the class-level
    41	compatibility pulled to the fine overlaps through the two factorizations of each comparison.  The
    42	widened certified-input gluing core produces the glued class, and the restriction law at the
    43	coarse level follows by Zariski separation (`DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq`) over each `S i` against
    44	its fine cover.
    45	
    46	## Main declarations
    47	
    48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_away_compat` — the keystone.
    49	-/

    71	    [CommRing B] [CommRing D] [Algebra R₀ A] [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra R₀ D]
    72	    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D]

    82	/-- **THE PINNED KEYSTONE AT THE WIDENED CARRIER — Zariski gluing of widened locally certified
    83	divisor classes** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2, at the R2 value of I-0492): for a finite
    84	span-⊤ family `g : ι → R` with away carriers `S i` and overlap carriers `T i j`, widened locally
    85	certified classes `F i : DivFamZarAff C (S i) n` compatible on the overlaps glue: there is
    86	`F₀ : DivFamZarAff C R n` with `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F₀ = F i` for all `i`.

    90	it is field-uniform: no hypothesis on `|P¹(k)|` occurs anywhere in the statement or its route. -/
    91	theorem DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_away_compat
    92	    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R) (S : ι → Type u)
    93	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
    94	    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
    95	    (T : ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra k (T i j)]
    96	    [∀ i j, Algebra R (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k R (T i j)]
    97	    [∀ i j, Algebra (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra (S j) (T i j)]
    98	    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S j) (T i j)]
    99	    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S j) (T i j)]
   100	    [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (g i * g j) (T i j)]
   101	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
   102	    (F : ∀ i, DivFamZarAff C (S i) n)
   103	    (hcompat : ∀ i j,
   104	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (T i j) n (F i) = DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (T i j) n (F j)) :
   105	    ∃ F₀ : DivFamZarAff C R n, ∀ i, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F₀ = F i := by
   106	  classical
   107	  -- representatives and their widened local certificate covers
   108	  have hrep := fun i => Quotient.exists_rep (F i)

   110	  choose m h hspan hGs using fun i => (dp i).2
   111	  haveI hImmU : ∀ (i : ι) (l : Fin (m i)),
   112	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l))) := fun i l =>
   113	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l)) (h i l)
   114	  have hGs' : ∀ (i : ι) (l : Fin (m i)),
   115	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away (h i l)) n,
   116	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
   117	          ((dp i).1.pullback (relCurveMap C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l)))
   118	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   119	              (relCurveMap C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l))) (dp i).1)) :=
   120	    fun i l => hGs i l

   126	    fun i l => IsLocalization.Away.associated_sec_fst (g i) (h i l)
   127	  have hr : Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i) =>
   128	      (IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1 * g p.1) = ⊤ :=
   129	    span_range_num_mul_eq_top g S hg h hspan
   130	      (fun i l => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (g i) (h i l)).1) hassoc
   131	  -- the fine carriers are away localizations of `R` at the composite cover

   133	      IsLocalization.Away ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1 * g p.1)
   134	        (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) := fun p => by
   135	    haveI : IsLocalization.Away
   136	        (algebraMap R (S p.1) ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1))
   137	        (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) :=
   138	      IsLocalization.Away.of_associated (hassoc p.1 p.2).symm
   139	    exact IsLocalization.Away.mul (S p.1) (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (g p.1)
   140	      ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1)
   141	  -- notation for the composite cover and the fine overlap carriers
   142	  set r : (Σ i : ι, Fin (m i)) → R :=
   143	    fun p => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1 * g p.1 with hrdef
   144	  -- the fine overlap carriers and their instance pack
   145	  haveI hVaway : ∀ p q : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i),
   146	      IsLocalization.Away (r p * r q)
   147	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (r q))) :=
   148	    fun p q => mul_comm (r q) (r p) ▸ inferInstance
   149	  letI algSq : ∀ p q : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i),
   150	      Algebra (Localization.Away (h q.1 q.2))
   151	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (r q))) :=
   152	    fun p q =>
   153	      (IsLocalization.Away.lift (r q) (S := Localization.Away (h q.1 q.2))
   154	        (g := algebraMap R
   155	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (r q))))
   156	        (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (x := r p * r q)
   157	          ⟨r p, mul_comm (r p) (r q)⟩)).toAlgebra
   158	  haveI towSqR : ∀ p q : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i),
   159	      IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (h q.1 q.2))
   160	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (r q))) :=
   161	    fun p q => IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   162	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
   163	  haveI towSqk : ∀ p q : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i),
   164	      IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (h q.1 q.2))
   165	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (r q))) :=
   166	    fun p q => isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := R)
   167	  letI algSj : ∀ p q : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i),
   168	      Algebra (S q.1)
   169	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (h p.1 p.2)) (r q))) :=

    40	    (F : forall p : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f p)) n)
    41	    (hcompat : forall p q : Fin m,
    42	      mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p) =
    43	        mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
    44	    ∃ F0 : DivFamZarAff C S n, forall p : Fin m,
    45	      mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F0 = F p := by
    46	  classical
    47	  letI algL : forall p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f p))
    48	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    49	    (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    50	  letI algR : forall p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f q))
    51	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    52	    (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra

    54	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    55	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
    56	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    57	      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap
    58	        (k := k) (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl x).symm)
    59	  haveI towSR : forall p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
    60	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    61	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
    62	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    63	      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap
    64	        (k := k) (f p * f q) (f q) (f p) (mul_comm _ _) x).symm)
    65	  haveI towkL : forall p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f p))
    66	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>

    68	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    69	      exact ((DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)

    74	      exact ((DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)

    86	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down))
    87	    (fun l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down))

    89	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
    90	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
    91	      exact hspan)
    92	    (fun l => F l.down) hkey

    95	    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) (fun _ => rfl)]
    96	  exact hF0 (ULift.up p)

    98	/-- Widened classes are separated by a finite spanning family of away localizations. -/
    99	theorem eq_of_awaySpan_eq {iota : Type} [Finite iota] (f : iota -> S)
   100	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) {F G : DivFamZarAff C S n}
   101	    (h : forall p : iota,
   102	      mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F =
   103	        mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) G) :
   104	    F = G := by
   105	  refine DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq n (fun l : ULift.{u} iota => f l.down)
   106	    (fun l : ULift.{u} iota => Localization.Away (f l.down))
   107	    (by
   108	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} iota => f l.down) = Set.range f from
   109	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
   110	      exact hspan)
   111	    (fun l => ?_)
   112	  rw [← mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
   113	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) F,
   114	    ← mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
   115	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) G]
   116	  exact h l.down
   117	
   118	/-- The widened canonical away-span glue is unique. -/
   119	theorem existsUnique_glue_of_awaySpan {m : Nat} (f : Fin m -> S)
   120	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
   121	    (F : forall p : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f p)) n)
   122	    (hcompat : forall p q : Fin m,
   123	      mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p) =
   124	        mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
   125	    ∃! F0 : DivFamZarAff C S n, forall p : Fin m,
   126	      mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F0 = F p := by
   127	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ := exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
   128	  exact ⟨F0, hF0, fun F1 hF1 =>
   129	    eq_of_awaySpan_eq f hspan (fun p => (hF1 p).trans (hF0 p).symm)⟩

    10	
    11	**The pinned keystone, ported to the widened carrier** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2 at
    12	`DivFamZarAff`): compatible widened locally certified divisor classes over a finite away cover of
    13	`R` glue to a widened class over `R` restricting to them.
    14	
    15	## Why this ports, and where the only real work was
    16	
    17	R2 (human decision I-0492) widened where the certificate's pieces live ON THE CURVE — arbitrary
    18	affine opens instead of basic opens of two pinned `P¹` charts.  It changed NOTHING about the
    19	Zariski cover of the BASE, and the gluing argument is entirely about the base: it assembles a
    20	divisor with `awayGluedEquationsLoc` and witnesses local certifiability by `mapAlg` of the input
    21	families.  So the route below is the chart-typed `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` with three
    22	mechanical substitutions — `DivFamZar → DivFamZarAff`, `CertifiedDivisorFamily →
    23	CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`, and no `π` anywhere — plus two real costs:
    24	
    25	* the assembly had to be **restated at bare local-equation systems** first, because its
    26	  chart-typed statement demands `CertifiedDivisorFamily` input that a widened class provably
    27	  cannot supply.  That is `DivisorFamilyAffGlueZarKit.lean`; the proof there is verbatim.
    28	* every `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg` carries the overlap-affineness argument `hinf`, free
    29	  here from `[IsProper C.hom]` via `AffCoverData.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper`, which is also
    30	  what `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` itself needs.  Hence `[IsProper C.hom]` in the statement — the DD-R
    31	  lane has it everywhere, the challenge curve being proper over `k`.
    32	
    33	## The route, unchanged from the chart-typed keystone
    34	
    35	Representatives `d i` carry widened local certificate covers `h i : Fin (m i) → S i` with
    36	certified families `G i l` over `Localization.Away (h i l)`.  The composite cover
    37	`r ⟨i, l⟩ := a i l * g i` (numerators `a i l` of the `h i l`, `IsLocalization.Away.sec`) spans `⊤`
    38	(`span_range_num_mul_eq_top`), and the fine carriers `Localization.Away (h i l)` are
    39	`r ⟨i, l⟩`-away localizations of `R`.  The fine overlap carriers receive the coarse overlap
    40	carriers `T i j` by `IsLocalization.Away.lift`; the fine compatibility follows from the class-level
    41	compatibility pulled to the fine overlaps through the two factorizations of each comparison.  The

    98	    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S j) (T i j)]
    99	    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S j) (T i j)]
   100	    [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (g i * g j) (T i j)]
   101	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)

   105	    ∃ F₀ : DivFamZarAff C R n, ∀ i, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F₀ = F i := by

   108	  have hrep := fun i => Quotient.exists_rep (F i)
   109	  choose dp hdp using hrep
   110	  choose m h hspan hGs using fun i => (dp i).2
   111	  haveI hImmU : ∀ (i : ι) (l : Fin (m i)),
   112	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l))) := fun i l =>

   114	  have hGs' : ∀ (i : ι) (l : Fin (m i)),
   115	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away (h i l)) n,
   116	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
   117	          ((dp i).1.pullback (relCurveMap C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l)))
   118	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   119	              (relCurveMap C (S i) (Localization.Away (h i l))) (dp i).1)) :=
   120	    fun i l => hGs i l

   124	      Associated (algebraMap R (S i) ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (g i) (h i l)).1))

   126	    fun i l => IsLocalization.Away.associated_sec_fst (g i) (h i l)
   127	  have hr : Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (m i) =>
   128	      (IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1 * g p.1) = ⊤ :=

   130	      (fun i l => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (g i) (h i l)).1) hassoc

   133	      IsLocalization.Away ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (g p.1) (h p.1 p.2)).1 * g p.1)

    36	-- The canonical overlap carrier elaborates both localization towers simultaneously.
    37	/-- Widened locally certified classes on a canonical finite away cover glue. -/
    38	theorem exists_glue_of_awaySpan {m : Nat} (f : Fin m -> S)
    39	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    40	    (F : forall p : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f p)) n)
    41	    (hcompat : forall p q : Fin m,
    42	      mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p) =
    43	        mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
    44	    ∃ F0 : DivFamZarAff C S n, forall p : Fin m,
    45	      mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F0 = F p := by
    46	  classical
    47	  letI algL : forall p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f p))
    48	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    49	    (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    50	  letI algR : forall p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f q))
    51	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    52	    (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    53	  haveI towSL : forall p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f p))
    54	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    55	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
    56	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    57	      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap
    58	        (k := k) (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl x).symm)
    59	  haveI towSR : forall p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
    60	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    61	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
    62	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    63	      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap
    64	        (k := k) (f p * f q) (f q) (f p) (mul_comm _ _) x).symm)
    65	  haveI towkL : forall p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f p))
    66	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    67	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
    68	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    69	      exact ((DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
    70	  haveI towkR : forall p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f q))
    71	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    72	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
    73	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    74	      exact ((DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
    75	  have hkey : forall l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
    76	      mapAlg (Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down)) n (F l.down) =
    77	        mapAlg (Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down)) n (F l'.down) := by
    78	    intro l l'
    79	    rw [← mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f l.down l'.down)
    80	        (fun _ => rfl),
    81	      ← mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f l.down l'.down)
    82	        (fun _ => rfl)]
    83	    exact hcompat l.down l'.down
    84	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_away_compat
    85	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
    86	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down))
    87	    (fun l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down))
    88	    (by
    89	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
    90	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
    91	      exact hspan)
    92	    (fun l => F l.down) hkey
    93	  refine ⟨F0, fun p => ?_⟩
    94	  rw [mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
    95	    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) (fun _ => rfl)]
    96	  exact hF0 (ULift.up p)

   312	
   313	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
   314	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section

   319	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

   334	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

This theorem is tied to the presentation’s own `datumSectionBaseChange`, has explicit fibrewise nonvanishing hypotheses, and immediately becomes the existing fixed-open canonicality consumer; I’m adding it in the recovery-owned local-divisor module and removing the duplicated proof body.

-- The dependent local-equation constructors and restriction maps need a larger elaboration budget.
/-- A localized unit relating two tied datum sections transports the resulting local equations by
pointwise unit rescaling on the canonical pointed cover. -/
theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_unit
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    (v : (Localization.Away f)ˣ)
    (hsec : P.datumSectionBaseChange (Localization.Away f) y' =
      (v : Localization.Away f) • P.datumSectionBaseChange (Localization.Away f) y) :
    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
      (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy)
      (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y' hy') := by
  let B := Localization.Away f
  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) := P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
  let s' : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) := P.datumSectionBaseChange B y'
  have hs : s' = (v : B) • s := hsec
  have hcomp : ∀ j : D.index, D.component s' j = (v : B) • D.component s j := by
    intro j
    calc
      D.component s' j = D.component ((v : B) • s) j := by
        exact congrArg (fun t => D.component t j) hs
      _ = (v : B) • D.component s j :=
        baseChange_component_smul (C := C) (pi := pi) D (v : B) s j
  simp only [baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations,
    sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange]
  apply Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq.symm
  dsimp [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations]
  refine ⟨D.pointedCover, le_rfl, le_rfl, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let a : B →+* Γ(relCurve C B, D.pointedCover.opens x) :=
    (relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pointedCover.opens x)
  refine ⟨Units.map a.toMonoidHom v, ?_⟩
  simp only [hs]
  rw [hcomp]
  simp only [Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
  change (relCurve C B).resHom _ ((relCurve C B).resHom _ _) =
    (Units.map a.toMonoidHom v : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pointedCover.opens x)) *
      (relCurve C B).resHom _ ((relCurve C B).resHom _ _)
  simp only [map_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
  congr 1
  change (relCurve C B).resHom _ ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B _ (v : B)) =
    a (v : B)
  exact (relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap_apply_res B
    (homOfLE (le_of_eq (D.pointedCover_opens x))).op (v : B)

theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_divEq
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
      (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy)
      (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y' hy') := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ :=
    P.existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators f y y' hy hy'
  exact P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_unit f y y' hy hy' v
    (P.datumSectionBaseChange_eq_smul_of_tensor_eq

     9	# Base change of the pinned cocycle datum (DAT-1, stage 1d-ii, the datum half)
    10	
    11	The `relCocycleBaseChange`-style base change of the basic-open cocycle datum
    12	(`informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1d-ii), first bullet; worksheet §3.2 — **this is the
    13	RE-5 transport interface**): along a `k`-algebra map `B → B'`, the generators, partition
    14	coefficients and transition units of a `Scheme.BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` push forward
    15	through the relative-curve comparison morphism `relCurveMap C B B'` to a datum over `B'`,
    16	with the pieces mapping to pieces (`Scheme.preimage_basicOpen`) and the partition/cocycle
    17	identities carried by `map_*`.
    18

    20	  both sides (the workhorse; both sides collapse to one `appLE` by
    21	  `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance).

    23	  opens.

    25	  maps along `algebraMap B B'`, over **arbitrary** opens (the pullback-open case is the

    31	  (`sectionsMap_add`), semilinear along `algebraMap B B'` (`sectionsMap_smul`),

    33	  trivializations with the section comparison (`gluedTriv_sectionsMap`) and the

    50	/-! ## `appLE` against restriction, on arbitrary opens -/
    51	
    52	/-- **`appLE` commutes with restriction**: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, restricting the `appLE`
    53	image of a section equals the `appLE` image of the restricted section. Both sides are
    54	`f.appLE W PW'` of the section, by `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance of the
    55	inclusion witnesses. -/
    56	lemma Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X.Hom Y) {W' W : Y.Opens}
    57	    {PW' PW : X.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) (ePW : PW ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (ePW' : PW' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W')
    58	    (hP : PW' ≤ PW) (s : Γ(Y, W)) :
    59	    X.resHom hP ((f.appLE W PW ePW).hom s) =
    60	      (f.appLE W' PW' ePW').hom (Y.resHom hW s) := by
    61	  have h1 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    62	    $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map f ePW (homOfLE hP).op)) s)
    63	  have h2 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    64	    $(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f ePW' (homOfLE hW).op)) s)
    65	  exact h1.trans h2.symm

    75	/-- **Basic opens base-change to basic opens**: the basic open of the compared section
    76	`relSectionsMap s` is the `relCurveMap`-preimage of the basic open of `s`. -/
    77	theorem relSectionsMap_basicOpen (V : C.left.Opens)
    78	    (s : Γ(relCurve C B, (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    79	    (relCurve C B').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C B B' V s) =
    80	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((relCurve C B).basicOpen s) := by
    81	  have happ : relSectionsMap C B B' V s =
    82	      (relCurve C B').resHom
    83	        (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm :
    84	          (fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤
    85	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    86	        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) := by
    87	    have h := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    88	      $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (relCurveMap C B B')
    89	        (le_refl (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
    90	        (homOfLE (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).op)) s)
    91	    have h0 : ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    92	        (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom s =
    93	        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) :=
    94	      congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    95	        $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (relCurveMap C B B')
    96	          (U := (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))) s)
    97	    calc relSectionsMap C B B' V s
    98	        = ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    99	            ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   100	            (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).hom s := rfl
   101	      _ = (relCurve C B').resHom (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)
   102	            (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   103	              (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
   104	              le_rfl).hom s) := h.symm
   105	      _ = _ := by rw [h0]
   106	  rw [happ, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom,
   107	    ← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen (relCurveMap C B B') s,
   108	    ← relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V, ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   109	  congr 1
   110	  exact inf_eq_right.mpr ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le s)

   114	/-- `appLE` is invariant under an equality of morphisms. -/
   115	private lemma appLE_congr_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) {U : Y.Opens}
   116	    {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
   117	    f.appLE U W e = g.appLE U W (h ▸ e) := by
   118	  subst h; rfl

   123	`appLE` image of the structure pullback of `r : B` is the structure pullback of
   124	`algebraMap B B' r` (the landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap` is the pullback-open
   125	case `W = V_B`). -/
   126	theorem relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap {W : (relCurve C B).Opens}
   127	    {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hle : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (r : B) :
   128	    ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle).hom
   129	        ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B W r) =
   130	      (relCurve C B').overAlgebraMap B' W' (algebraMap B B' r) := by
